versions.changelog:
- Major update introducing detailed multi-dimensional Amazon listing health audits: integrates CDQ (content quality), A9 (indexability), COSMO (intent coverage), Alexa (discoverability), plus compliance checks.
- Now supports diagnosis (not rewriting), generating health reports with granular scores, critical issue identification, and prioritized fix lists.
- Accepts listings as pasted text, URL, or ASIN, normalizing all inputs to a consistent JSON schema; missing data results in transparent scoring downgrades, not errors.
- Enhanced support for global users: works in any language, including simplified workflows for 中文卖家 (Chinese sellers).
- Zero dependencies and works fully offline; emphasizes reliable, partial results even with incomplete data.
- Comprehensive documentation and workflow guides added.
